note: The missing spans of every body that compiles SHORTER than its extent, found by ALIGNING the two word lists (difflib) rather than indexing them. `aligned` is the alignment identity, `positional` the index identity distance.json records — the two disagree wildly on this population, which is why the map could not rank it. `in_gap` counts missing instructions that touch a stack slot between our frame and the image's: that is the omitted-local signature and the only class a local template can supply.
